newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Chowchilla USD, Calif..
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Chowchilla USD, Calif..

text.p: NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN, pursuant to section 53692 of the California Government Code, that the Board of Supervisors of Madera County, California (the Board''), in the name the Chowchilla Union High School District, intends to sell, at public sale, $1,300,000 Chowchilla Union High School District (Madera County, California) 1997 Tax and Revenue Anticipation Notes. Bids will be received at 10:30 A.M., Pacific time, on

and, without further advertising, so long as a proposal has not theretofore been accepted by the Board, on Monday, June 9, 1997, and Monday, June 16, 1997, at the offices of Rauscher Pierce Refsnes, Inc., One Market Plaza, 1100 Steuart Street Tower, San Francisco, California, and the sale will be awarded by the Board within 26 hours after the expiration of the time prescribed for the receipt of bids. The sale of the Notes will be conducted upon the terms and conditions set forth in the Official Notice of Sale for the Notes. Such Official Notice of Sale and the Preliminary Official Statement describing the Notes will be distributed to prospective bidders by the financial advisor to the District, Rauscher Pierce Refsnes, Inc., One Market Plaza, 1100 Steuart Street Tower, San Francisco, CA 94105,
Telephone (415) 979-0300. Bids will be entertained only from bidders to whom such Official Notice of Sale and Preliminary Official Statement have been distributed.
